creative_direction.core_message: As agents take over typing, the valuable work moves to intent, review and judgment.
creative_direction.viewer_benefit: Know which skills to invest in as coding agents improve.

claims.text: Coding agents can plan a change, edit files and run tests.
Agent output is only as reliable as the tests and review around it.

scenes.narration: Coding is turning into a conversation.
scenes.heading: Coding is a conversation
scenes.visual_intent: Establishing mood: the late-night developer desk, quiet and focused

cinematic.prompt: Slow dolly toward a developer desk at night, monitor glow on a face out of focus, shallow depth of field, warm practical lights, premium technology commercial look, clean composition with empty space in the upper third for titles

scenes.narration: You describe the change. An agent plans it, edits the files, and runs the tests.
scenes.heading: From request to tested change
scenes.visual_intent: The new loop as clear ordered steps

scenes.narration: Your job shifts to review: reading diffs instead of typing boilerplate.
scenes.heading: Review the diff
scenes.visual_intent: A real-looking diff as the object of attention

scenes.narration: Teams will spend more time on intent, architecture, and judgment.
scenes.heading: Intent, architecture, judgment

cinematic.prompt: Wide shot of a small product team around a whiteboard in a sunlit studio, slow lateral camera move, soft natural light, cinematic color grade, no readable writing, no logos

scenes.narration: Typing speed matters less. Clear thinking matters more.
scenes.heading: What gets valuable
scenes.visual_intent: A simple before/after of where effort goes

scenes.narration: The catch: an agent is only as good as your tests and your review.

points: Tests and review are the guardrails
